role: The dropped-item entity: the stack a broken block, death, Q key or container spill spawns, which bounces, floats on water, burns, stacks with neighbours, despawns after 6000 ticks and is picked up by players.
scope_reason: Item drops are core survival behaviour, not switched off in world.conf.

notes: Verified item_update, combine_items, search_other_items, ie_attack_from, water_accelerate and the constructor draws in csrc/engine/item_entity.c; the pickup body in csrc/engine/survival.c:1478-1555. The Q-drop thrower naming is covered by the DEVLOG cat-toss lane entry. I did not verify the nether-star explosion guard against a recording. lane/clientents: the live client's own EntityItem copies (csrc/play/clientents.c citem_update: the water push, pushOutOfBlocks with its Random's mean speed, moveEntity over the client world, friction, bounce, age; no merge, no lava hop) from its EntityTracker emulation; their hoverStart is the server's (the client's comes from Math.random). lane/idxentity: a mob's loot pickup now sees the player's and the blocks' drops (both item pools, ie_items_within_aabb), and a thrown diamond it picks up grants diamondsToYou (ent-loot-s42).
